find: and raise its Bounciness to 0.8. Drag it onto the Material box of the Sphere Collider, which reads None (Physics Material). If the bounces are weak, the floor has no material so the bounce is averaged: set Bounce Combine on PM_Bouncy to Maximum.

Bounce Combine matters because the floor has no physics material: left on Average, the ball’s 0.8 is averaged with the floor’s 0 and it bounces only once.
why: Measured: Average gives one bounce, Maximum gives eight or more.
